notes.title: Trading Cards are now available!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32282487/7445f3b6cc5731a893b5c24ce191e4f683c83b2c.png[/img]

It's been a while since the release of Sweep'n'Sweep, but despite that, Steam Trading Cards were added to the game. There are 8 cards in total, along with four different backgrounds and five emoticons.

Craft your Sweep'n'Sweep badge today!

notes.title: Sweep'n'Sweep Store Page is now live!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce the release of our first ever game to Steam! The release is scheduled to happen on March 20, 2018 at 10 AM PST.

To be notified when the game is released, make sure to add the game to your wishlist.

We can't wait to see people finally having fun with Sweep'n'Sweep!
